faq: Does one change work on both stores?
Yes. The Flutter code is shared, so a rebuilt onboarding appears on iOS and Android together. Store-specific parts, such as billing screens and permission wording, follow each platform's own rules.
Will this raise my conversion rate?
We cannot promise a number. We remove friction we can see and add tracking so you can measure each change. Results depend on your product, price and traffic.
Which analytics tool will you use?
Firebase Analytics unless you prefer another. We add only agreed events, and help you match the Apple privacy labels and the Play Data safety form to what the app collects.
We can design how prices are shown and add test variants, but you choose the prices. We follow store rules on showing prices, trial terms and restore purchases clearly.
